questions.stem: 近年來，許多大學的學費漲得比物價還快，迫使不少學生申請助學貸款。
questions.answer: In recent years, tuition fees at many universities have risen faster than inflation, forcing many students to apply for student loans.
accepted_answers: In recent years, the tuition of many universities has gone up faster than prices, forcing quite a few students to take out student loans.
Over the past few years, tuition fees at many universities have increased faster than the cost of living, forcing many students to take out student loans.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（, forcing …）

questions.stem: 然而，背負大筆學貸畢業，常被視為年輕人延後結婚的主要原因之一。
questions.answer: However, graduating with heavy student loans is often seen as one of the main reasons why young people postpone marriage.
accepted_answers: However, graduating with large student loans is often regarded as one of the major reasons why young people put off getting married.
However, graduating with a huge amount of student debt is often considered one of the main reasons for young people postponing marriage.

patterns: 被動語態（is often seen as）

1.explanation_zh: 「近年來」用 In recent years，搭配現在完成式。「許多大學的學費漲得比物價還快」：主詞 tuition fees at many universities，「漲」是不及物的 rise（have risen），「比物價還快」用比較級副詞 faster than inflation（物價上漲就是 inflation；than prices、than the cost of living 也可以）。「迫使不少學生申請助學貸款」是前面情況造成的結果，中文沒有主詞，英文用句尾分詞 , forcing many students to apply for student loans；「申請」要寫 apply for（或 take out a loan）。
evidence: 迫使不少學生申請助學貸款
1.strategy_zh: 「近年來」先想現在完成式；「A 比 B 還快」用 faster than；句尾「迫使…」用 , forcing + O + to VR。
hints: 切成四段：近年來，許多大學的學費／漲得比物價還快／迫使不少學生／申請助學貸款
標的詞彙：recent（近來的）、university（大學）、tuition（學費）、rise（上漲）、price（物價）、force（迫使）、student（學生）、apply（申請）、loan（貸款）
句型框架：In recent years, S + have risen faster than + N, forcing + O + to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 主詞是動作「背負大筆學貸畢業」，英文用動名詞片語 Graduating with heavy student loans（loans 用複數），動詞用單數 is。「常被視為」用被動 is often seen as／regarded as，as 不能省。「…主要原因之一」是 one of the main reasons，reasons 一定用複數；「年輕人延後結婚的（原因）」寫 why young people postpone marriage（或 delay getting married，delay／postpone 後面接名詞或動名詞）。
2.strategy_zh: 主詞是一件事（動作）時，用動名詞片語當主詞、動詞用單數；「被視為…之一」先寫 be seen as one of the + 複數名詞。
hints: 切成四段：然而，背負大筆學貸畢業／常被視為／年輕人延後結婚的／主要原因之一
標的詞彙：graduate（畢業）、heavy（大筆的）、student（學生）、loan（貸款）、regard（視為）、young（年輕的）、delay（延後）、marry（結婚）、main（主要的）、reason（原因）
句型框架：However, V-ing … + is often seen as one of the main reasons why + S + V …

bonus.text: In recent years, tuition fees at many universities have outpaced inflation, leaving many students with no choice but to take out student loans.
bonus.explanation_zh: outpace（比…成長得快）一個字就表達「漲得比…還快」，leave sb with no choice but to VR（讓某人不得不…）是進階搭配；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「迫使不少學生…」接在逗號後、沒有主詞，英文用句尾分詞 , forcing many students to …；「漲得比物價還快」用比較級副詞 faster than，「漲」是不及物的 rise。
1.notes_zh: 評分說明：「近年來」In recent years／Over (In) the past few years，配現在完成式；「許多大學的學費」tuition (fees) at many universities、the tuition (fees) of many universities、many universities' tuition fees；「漲得比物價還快」have／has risen（gone up、increased、been rising）faster／more quickly than prices（inflation、the cost of living、consumer prices 都可以），主詞 tuition 用 has、tuition fees 用 have；「迫使」forcing／compelling／pushing／driving，寫成 , which has forced／forces many students to …（which 指前面整件事）也算達成本句 PART 標的；「不少學生」many／quite a few／a lot of students；「申請助學貸款」apply for／take out (a) student loan(s)。另外也給分：commodity prices、the prices of goods、general prices、have climbed／grown faster than prices、have risen more sharply than inflation。

traps.literal_error: However, graduate with heavy student loans is often seen as one of the main reasons why young people postpone marriage.

1.translation: In recent years, tuition fees at many universities have risen faster than prices in general, forcing many students to apply for student loans.
1.explanation_zh: 「近年來」配現在完成式 have risen；「物價」譯 prices in general（也可 the cost of living）；「迫使」用分詞構句 forcing … to apply for；「不少學生」譯 many students。

2.translation: However, graduating with large student loans is often regarded as one of the main reasons why young people delay getting married.
2.explanation_zh: 「背負大筆學貸畢業」當主詞用動名詞 graduating with large student loans；「被視為…之一」用 be regarded as one of the main reasons why；「延後結婚」用 delay + V-ing。

1.translation: In recent years, tuition at many universities has risen faster than prices, forcing quite a few students to apply for student loans.
1.explanation_zh: 「近年來」搭配現在完成式 has risen；「漲得比物價還快」用 risen faster than prices；「迫使不少學生申請助學貸款」用分詞構句 forcing quite a few students to apply for student loans。

2.translation: However, graduating with a large student debt is often regarded as one of the main reasons why young people put off getting married.
2.explanation_zh: 「背負大筆學貸畢業」用動名詞片語 graduating with a large student debt 當主詞；「被視為……主要原因之一」用 is regarded as one of the main reasons；「延後結婚」用 put off getting married（也可用 delay getting married），reasons why 引導關係子句。

issues_zh: 盲譯寫 graduating with a large student debt（單數可數的 debt 加冠詞），文法可行，但第 1 部分的 accepted 只收到 a large student loan、heavy／huge student debt(s)、a large amount of student debt 等，沒有 a large student debt、a heavy student debt、large student debts 這類寫法；建議補進 accepted，或由出題者決定這種寫法是否算不夠道地。

problems: 第 2 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義

status_reason: blind_solver:B 未通過：第 2 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義；判定者人工審查（第 1 輪）：同意退回。驗證者 B 的盲譯 graduating with a large student debt 文法正確、語意忠實（debt 可當可數名詞，a large debt 是常見搭配），但第 2 題第 1 部分 accepted 只收 a large student loan debt、large student debts、heavy／a lot of student debt 等，漏了 a large student debt、large student debt、a heavy student debt；評分規準太窄。重生時第 1 部分補上 debt 的單數可數與不可數寫法。第 1 題沒有問題。
